# Chris Pearce

> Computer Science student at Santa Clara University (Data Science emphasis) building end-to-end ML systems and full-stack products — from CNN image classifiers and LLM-driven agents to Next.js/Django web apps.

## Projects

### AI Creator Marketing Platform (Jun 2025 – Sep 2025, personal project)
A content-generation platform built in Next.js where creators upload videos and notes and get automatically generated, platform-specific outreach content. Includes a scalable backend asset-processing system in Python deployed on Railway (Poetry for dependency management), PostgreSQL + Clerk for auth and user data, and CI/CD deployment workflows across environments.
Stack: Next.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Railway, CI/CD

### Rice Strain CNN Classifier (Jan 2026 – Mar 2026, university project)
Built and evaluated CNN and linear neural network models to classify 5 rice grain varieties across a 75,000-image dataset, reaching ~97-98% accuracy. Implemented the full ML pipeline: preprocessing (grayscale conversion, resizing, normalization), architecture design, and training with SGD and cross-entropy loss. Also built an OpenCV object detection pipeline (thresholding, contour detection, bounding boxes) to classify rice grains in real-world images.
Stack: PyTorch, CNN, OpenCV, Computer Vision

### SCU Marketplace Web App (Sep 2025 – Dec 2025, university project)
A marketplace app for students to create, post, and browse listings for used items, similar to Facebook Marketplace. Password-protected accounts with contact info, location, and SCU ID verification. Frontend in Next.js with responsive, dynamic page navigation; backend in Django handling CRUD operations, API routing, and request validation on SQLite.
Stack: Next.js, Django, SQLite, REST APIs

### Email Outreach Automation Bot (Aug 2024 – Oct 2024, personal project)
Designed AI-assisted outreach agents using the OpenAI API and Zapier orchestration for high-volume, personalized outreach. Built adaptive prompt templates that adjust tone and content dynamically based on recipient data, and coordinated automated task flows across integrated APIs for reliable, autonomous scheduling.
Stack: OpenAI API, Zapier, Agentic AI
